nodes.name: RedissonCommonAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot auto-configuration that builds the shared RedissonClient in single-server mode with a custom executor thread pool and registers the RedissonDataHandle, LocalLockCache, and LockInfoHandleFactory beans.

nodes.name: RedissonCommonAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Auto-configuration class providing the Redisson client and the common locking infrastructure beans used by the service-lock and repeat-execute-limit frameworks.

nodes.name: redissonClient
nodes.summary: Creates a RedissonClient from Spring Redis properties, configuring address, timeouts, database, password, thread counts, and a custom ThreadPoolExecutor for Redisson task execution.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring ReflectionUtils to support multiple Redisson Config API variants.

nodes.name: LockInfoType.java
nodes.summary: Constant holder defining the lock-info type names (REPEAT_EXECUTE_LIMIT, SERVICE_LOCK) used to select LockInfoHandle implementations from the Spring context.

nodes.name: LockInfoType
nodes.summary: Declares string constants naming the two lock-info categories whose values double as Spring bean names for LockInfoHandle lookups.

nodes.name: RedissonDataHandle.java
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over RedissonClient RBucket providing get/set operations with optional TTL and TimeUnit-to-Duration conversion, used to store repeat-execute success flags.

nodes.name: RedissonDataHandle
nodes.summary: Encapsulates simple Redis value reads/writes through Redisson buckets, including TTL-aware set overloads backed by Duration conversion.

nodes.name: getDuration
nodes.summary: Converts a TTL value and TimeUnit into a java.time.Duration, supporting minutes, hours, and days with seconds as the fallback.

nodes.name: LocalLockCache.java
nodes.summary: Caffeine-based local cache of JVM ReentrantLock instances keyed by lock name, providing a first-level in-process lock before distributed locking is attempted.

nodes.name: LocalLockCache
nodes.summary: Maintains an expiring Caffeine cache mapping lock keys to ReentrantLock instances so repeated lock requests reuse the same JVM monitor.

nodes.name: AbstractLockInfoHandle.java
nodes.summary: Base LockInfoHandle implementation that derives lock names from annotation attributes and evaluates SpEL key expressions against join-point method arguments.

nodes.name: AbstractLockInfoHandle
nodes.summary: Implements lock-name resolution by combining an environment-specific prefix, the annotation name, and SpEL-evaluated business keys extracted from method parameters.

nodes.name: simpleGetLockName
nodes.summary: Builds a lock name without a join point by joining the prefix distinction name, the annotation name, and any non-blank literal keys.

nodes.name: getMethod
nodes.summary: Resolves the concrete Method behind an AOP join point, falling back to the target class declared method when the signature method comes from an interface.

nodes.name: getSpElKey
nodes.summary: Evaluates each SpEL key expression against a MethodBasedEvaluationContext built from the intercepted method and its argument values, returning the resolved key strings.

nodes.name: LockInfoHandle.java
nodes.summary: Interface defining how a lock name is derived, either from an AOP join point with SpEL keys (getLockName) or from a plain name and literal keys (simpleGetLockName).

nodes.name: LockInfoHandle
nodes.summary: Contract for lock-name resolution strategies; implementations are looked up as Spring beans named by LockInfoType constants.

nodes.name: LockInfoHandleFactory.java
nodes.summary: ApplicationContextAware factory that returns the LockInfoHandle Spring bean whose name matches the requested lock-info type.

nodes.name: LockInfoHandleFactory
nodes.summary: Captures the ApplicationContext on startup and resolves LockInfoHandle beans by name at runtime, decoupling aspects from concrete handle classes.

nodes.name: ExtParameterNameDiscoverer.java
nodes.summary: Parameter-name discoverer that prefers LocalVariableTableParameterNameDiscoverer when not running in a GraalVM native image, enabling SpEL argument-name resolution.

nodes.name: ExtParameterNameDiscoverer
nodes.summary: Extends PrioritizedParameterNameDiscoverer, registering the local-variable-table discoverer outside native images so debug-class-file parameter names are available.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Auto-configuration registering the repeat-execute-limit LockInfoHandle bean and the RepeatExecuteLimitAspect that enforces duplicate-request protection.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Wires RepeatExecuteLimitLockInfoHandle and RepeatExecuteLimitAspect beans, injecting the local lock cache, lock-info factory, lock factory, and Redisson data handle.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitLockInfoHandle.java
nodes.summary: LockInfoHandle implementation for the repeat-execute-limit feature, supplying the REPEAT_EXECUTE_LIMIT lock-name prefix.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitLockInfoHandle
nodes.summary: Extends AbstractLockInfoHandle, returning the repeat-execute-limit prefix so lock names for duplicate-submission checks are namespaced.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitAspect.java
nodes.summary: AOP around-aspect that prevents duplicate method execution: it checks a Redis success flag, then guards the invocation with a local JVM lock followed by a distributed lock, marking success in Redis afterwards.

nodes.name: RepeatExecuteLimitAspect
nodes.summary: Aspect enforcing idempotent execution of @RepeatExecuteLimit methods through a Redis flag plus layered local and distributed locking, raising DaMaiFrameException on duplicates.

nodes.name: around
nodes.summary: Around advice that rejects already-executed requests via a Redis flag, acquires local and distributed locks with double-checked flag verification, proceeds, records success, and unlocks in finally blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses double-checked locking across two lock layers (local ReentrantLock and distributed Redisson lock).

nodes.name: ServiceLockAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Auto-configuration wiring the service-lock framework beans: ServiceLockInfoHandle, ManageLocker, ServiceLockFactory, ServiceLockAspect, and ServiceLockTool.

nodes.name: ServiceLockAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Registers all service-lock infrastructure beans so @ServiceLock annotations and programmatic ServiceLockTool locking work out of the box.

nodes.name: ManageLocker.java
nodes.summary: Registry holding one ServiceLocker implementation per LockType (reentrant, fair, write, read), all backed by a shared RedissonClient and exposed through getters.

nodes.name: ManageLocker
nodes.summary: Constructs and caches the four Redisson-backed ServiceLocker implementations in a map keyed by LockType, serving them to ServiceLockFactory.
